meta.based_on: 7.5 cm PaK 40/4 auf Raupenschlepper Ost (Sfl.), the armoured cab and the PaK 40 on a turntable
meta.notes: Rebuilt from the three-view drawing supplied with the request (3 m scale bar: 362 px per metre). Steyr 1500A V8 of 85 hp, 17 km/h on the road; the gun fires forward over the cab. The two driving covers open with I; full-open firing permits360-degree traverse. The retained parked arc, transition centering, front-cover hinge stops and per-bearing depression table are engineering clearance adaptations to this model.
